purpose: Design of the agenda mechanism: JSON-based recording, state transition rules, and automatic display regeneration for items (review findings, discussion points) handled by consult.
summary: Architecture: consult calls agenda_wrapper, which calls agenda_store, which auto-invokes agenda_render
Module list and responsibilities for wrapper, store, render, schema
Data schema of agenda.json: content_version, config, structural_judgment, items, decision
State representation without status field: settled when decision by/outcome/reason are all non-empty
last_changed_fields uniqueness: only the latest write is marked across the record
Transition prerequisites and structural judgment re-requirement when adding new items
CLI input interface: start, record (one value per call), next, pending, finish
Storage location, count, and lifetime per origin (review, consult)
Automatic re-render trigger after writes and failure handling
Test design and FNC-004 measurement method
tasks: Changing state transition or settlement rules
Adding record forms or CLI commands
Writing tests for the agenda store
title: DES-075 agenda 機構 設計書
